about: What's new, shown once in the island after Liv is updated (src/whats-new/). Every release adds its entry here, in English and Spanish: 1 to 4 items, a short title and one line each, an icon from ICON_NAMES (whats-new.ts). tests/whats-new.test.mjs checks the entry of the version that ships.

detail.en: A Dynamic Island for Windows, at the top of your screen.
detail.es: Una Dynamic Island para Windows, en lo alto de tu pantalla.

title.en: Your coding agents in the island
title.es: Tus agentes de programación en la isla

detail.en: Their sessions, questions and permission requests show up there.
detail.es: Sus sesiones, preguntas y solicitudes de permiso aparecen ahí.
